premises.text: Non-giant websites lack CDN-class speed and security teams that big sites buy
premises.evidence_span: The problem is we're not internet giants

premises.text: Cloudflare sits in front via DNS change only, works with any stack, and needs no hardware/software/code edits

premises.text: Network delivers faster loads (~30%) and blocks spam/attacks using distributed caching and layer-7 inspection/HTML rewrite
premises.evidence_span: Your traffic passes through our globally distributed network, and we make sure that the bad guys don't get to you

premises.text: Offered free while unit economics already cover variable costs
premises.evidence_span: Even though we haven't charged a single user, We are already making money on each. We're covering our variable costs
